lines.text: Why does a bank pay you interest?
lines.tts: Why does a bank pay you interest?

lines.text: Because your deposit isn't just sitting there.
lines.tts: Because your deposit isn't just sitting there.

lines.text: The bank lends it to other people and businesses.
lines.tts: The bank lends it to other people and businesses.

lines.text: They pay the bank interest on that loan.
lines.tts: They pay the bank interest on that loan.

lines.text: The bank keeps the difference, and shares a part with you.
lines.tts: The bank keeps the difference, and shares a part with you.

lines.text: You didn't know that about money.
